post.summary: Bootstrap the main organization and its first GroupAdmin user
post.description: Bootstrap endpoint. Creates an organization and its first GroupAdmin user in a single transaction.  A **random temporary password** is generated server-side for the GroupAdmin, stored only as a hash, and returned (once) in the response. The admin must change it after first login (`mustChangePassword = true`).  **Protection:** requires the `X-Bootstrap-Token` header to match the server's `ONBOARDING_SECRET`. Returns `409` if the organization code or admin username already exists.

patch.summary: 2nd Weighment — record loaded truck gross weight, generate challan (Operator+)
patch.description: Atomically: - Validates gross > tare - Resolves trader routing chain - Allocates royalty slips (unique-constraint protected) - Creates one `sales_leg` per chain link with sequential challan numbers - Records on-spot payment if `amountReceived > 0` - Updates weighment to COMPLETED  Idempotent: supply `Idempotency-Key` header. The server returns the same response for duplicate keys within 24 hours (safe for client retry after timeout).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID for safe retry. Cached result returned for 24 h on duplicate.

creditAcknowledged.description: Required true to dispatch a SOFT_BLOCK customer (operator acknowledges the credit warning).

requestOverride.description: For HARD_BLOCK customers without override permission: hold the dispatch as PENDING_APPROVAL and raise a credit override request to an admin. Requires overrideReason.

creditState.description: Customer credit state (live on read while PENDING; snapshot at decision)

newChallanNo.description: Issued from the new plant's series when the plant changes

rate.description: Override; else looked up from the section

rate.description: Override; else looked up from the section

isExCrusher.description: Ex-Crusher sites have zero transport rate

refreshToken.description: Use at POST /portal/refresh to get a new access token without re-login

invoiceId.description: Link receipt to a specific invoice

note.description: Optional on approve, required on reject

refreshToken.description: Rotated refresh token — replace the old one

mustChangePassword.description: True when the user must change a temporary password before using the app.

SecondWeighmentRequest.description: Hard Gate enforcement (server-side): - grossWt MUST exceed the recorded tare weight. - siteId MUST be assigned to the customer. - When royaltyGiven = true, etpNo MUST be provided (returns 422 if missing). - When amountReceived > 0, paymentMode is required.

grossWt.description: Loaded truck weight in KG; must exceed tare

cameraCaptures.description: Captured camera images at gross — base64 data URLs (one per camera). Each is stored as a GROSS-stage weighment photo (camera index 0,1,...).

customerId.description: Override customer if changed after tare

siteId.description: Delivery site — must be assigned to the customer

materialId.description: Override material if changed after tare

royaltyNumbers.description: Royalty slip numbers allocated to this trip. Required when royaltyGiven = true.

etpNo.description: ETP number — REQUIRED when royaltyGiven = true (Hard Gate #2)

amountReceived.description: Cash received on the spot (0 = no receipt)

ConfirmLoadRequest.description: Loader confirmation of the actual material and plant loaded. If these differ from the 1st weighment ticket the call returns 409 — raise POST /weighments/{id}/load-change-requests instead. password.description: Optional explicit password. Omit to auto-generate a one-time password (returned once in temporaryPassword), which the customer must change on first login.

resetPassword.description: Force-generate a new one-time password even if one already exists.
